notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31035706/6a71a837369f845d36d08c08cfb1072a555b83cb.jpgHappy New Year to our Chinese friends!

Greetings,

Today we have patched our High Mountain Roller Coaster VR to 1.1. We believe that with these fixes the roller coaster ride should be more pleasant and less glitchy.

Right, so we are going to continue on optimizing our game - feel free to let us know if you are still experiencing some issues. We will do what we can to solve them as soon as possible.

Until next time!
